scope_note: Independent visual review of receipts only. No integration, manifest, research or power changes. For each of the 11 requested slugs I viewed the native 1254px PNG, the 200px root thumbnail, and targeted native crops (heads/faces/eyes, hands and fingers, feet/hooves/claws, limbs for extra-limb checks, tongues, fins, weapons, clothing opacity, and background objects for pseudo-text or hidden figures), then compared them against the receipt visual_requirements and the research claims embedded in the ledger. Before writing, each PNG's SHA-256 was recomputed and matched against the receipt native_sha256, the Codex visual_review hash, the ledger item hash and the Codex root native-review hash in drafts/root/codex-native-reviews.json. Claude wrote only root_visual_review (plus correction_notes on the rejects) and the receipt status, and synced the ledger item status. The ledger was re-read immediately before writing, and only the item status changed. No PNG, Codex visual_review, Codex native review or other receipt was modified. Rejects: kunekune-urban-legend (hourglass mannequin in a graceful contrapposto with decorative ribbon arms, under soft pleasant daylight, reads as a paper sculpture, not an uncanny wriggle); matuku-tangotango (the wooden weapon is a European cruciform sword with a crossguard and pommel, only one hand shows on the two-handed weapon, and a photographic ordinary man in a shallow pit does not read as the underground ogre-chief); mulher-marinha (glamour-model face and golden-hour beach postcard, and at 200px the hybrid legs read as leggings and boots, so it is pretty rather than majestic).

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and torso/arm, head and feet crops. The anatomy matches the claims, and the r01 running/golden-hour problems are gone. It is one white crumpled paper/fine-fabric humanoid (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c04) with one blank egg-shaped head: no face, and the small dark patch under it is a crease, not a feature. Two ribbon-thin arms start at the shoulders and hang in long S-waves. It has two legs, and both feet are planted on the dike. The rice stalks and the paddy water are still (c03/c12/c13), and it is a rice field on a summer day (c01/c11). No text or aura. It still fails the sangar test. (1) The body is an hourglass mannequin: a narrow waist, swaying hips, one knee bent forward in a contrapposto, and the head tilted. The two ribbon arms hang in graceful, near-symmetric loops. That reads as an elegant fashion or dance pose of a paper sculpture, not an arrested convulsion. The 'wriggle' looks frozen and decorative, like rhythmic-gymnastics ribbons, not like something alive moving wrongly. (2) The light is soft, even daylight under a pale-blue sky with wispy clouds. There is no heat shimmer, no white-hot glare and almost no hard shadow, although both the r01 correction and the receipt's own prompt asked for them. The figure stands centred on the dike like a statue on a plinth. At 200px it reads as a land-art installation in a pleasant paddy: mildly odd, not dangerous. It fails Uji Sangar #2 and #7, reading as the calm, whimsical paper sculpture the prompt excluded.
results.correction_notes: Keep: one very slender white paper/fine-fabric humanoid with a blank faceless head, two ribbon-thin arms and two legs. Keep the feet planted in or beside the paddy, the rice and water dead still, and humanlike scale (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c03/c04/c11/c12/c13). Fix: (a) Make the wriggle read as wrong and alive, not graceful. Use a rail-thin, sexless, straight-hipped body, not an hourglass mannequin, with no contrapposto and no knee-forward model pose. The torso and both arms twist in many tight, uneven ripples along their whole length, like cloth whipped in a gale, and the head is jerked to a broken angle. Every rice blade and the water stay motionless around it. (b) Light: a bleached white-hot noon sky, heat haze visibly warping the far paddies, a harsh overhead sun, and a short hard black shadow at the feet. No pale-blue sky with wispy clouds. (c) Composition: a lower, closer, off-centre camera, so the figure looms over the viewer across the still water instead of standing centred on the path like a statue. No face, eyes, mouth, aura, curse or madness effects (c08), and no text.

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, weapon/hands, and lower-body/pit crops. What works: one adult humanlike ogre-chief with one head, two eyes and a roaring open mouth, long dark hair (matuku-tangotango-c04), and a fully opaque woven flax cloak and kilt (editorial). One knee is planted on the rim as he heaves himself out of a black pit with soil flying (rises up from beneath the earth, c06/c07). There is a pool behind (washing pool, c03), and no victim, gore, text or aura. It fails for three reasons. (1) The 'two-handed wooden sword' (c07) is drawn as a European cruciform sword carved in wood: a rectangular crossguard bar, a straight squared blade and a round pommel under the grip. That medieval Western hilt is foreign to Māori material culture, and it is the largest object in the frame. (2) Only ONE hand is visible on the grip. The other arm disappears behind the blade, so the two-handed grip the receipt claims does not read. (3) The face is a photographic portrait of an ordinary present-day Polynesian man shouting. Nothing marks him as the man-eating underground ogre-chief (c06/c09) rather than an angry warrior climbing out of a ditch, and the pit reads as a shallow hole, not an underground dwelling. A realistic Māori face cast as 'the ogre' with nothing else otherworldly also leans toward a savage-warrior stereotype. It fails the tradition/attribute check and Uji Sangar #5 and #7.
results.correction_notes: Keep: one humanlike ogre-chief with no invented horns, fangs, claws or giant size, long dark hair (matuku-tangotango-c04), an opaque flax cloak, a roaring confrontation with the viewer, and the moment of forcing himself up out of the earth (c06/c07) beside his washing pool (c03). Fix: (a) The weapon must be a long two-handed Māori-form hardwood striking weapon of plain dark wood, staff-like or with a flat paddle-edged blade. NO crossguard, NO pommel, NO metal, and nothing shaped like a European sword. (b) Show both hands clearly gripping the shaft. (c) Make the underground origin unmistakable. He climbs out of a deep black vertical shaft or cave mouth in the ground (Putawarenuku, c02/c09), with roots and soil streaming from his hair and cloak. Set it at dusk or night with a thin new-moon crescent visible low in the sky (c03/c06: he comes forth when the new moon appears), lit from the pool and the last light, so he reads as a creature risen from under the earth, not a man in a ditch. (d) Paint him in the house painterly style as a legendary figure with grave, earth-caked, weathered features, not a photographic portrait of a present-day man. No victim, gore, text or aura.

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head/beak, tongue-fork, feathered-back, coil, and both foot crops. One parrot head (mboi-tu-i-c02/c05) with a hooked macaw beak, seen in profile with one eye; the second eye is on the hidden side, not missing. The beak is wide open, and a long red tongue splits into exactly two forked tips (c05). Red, yellow and green feathers cover the head and lie along the back only (c05). The feathered mantle lies flat on the back and ends at the scaled body, so it is not a wing: there are no wings and no forearms. The body is a long scaled serpent whose coils loop through the water behind and under the torso (c05/c08). It has EXACTLY TWO legs on the torso (c05), each a scaled bird foot gripping a separate wet rock with curved talons. The colossal creature (c08/c13) rears over a low camera out of a great marsh (c11). Storm rain lashes the marsh under black clouds with one sunset gap (calls storms, c06), and the body throws up real splash. A crag and a hill rise behind (rocks and crags, Cavaju hill, c08/c11). No illness, victims, text or aura. It reads as a fearsome yet grand wetland guardian, strong at 200px. Original design.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and orchard, village and hail-covered-ground crops. The research documents no bodily form. Following the policy's aniconic option (a), the receipt records the choice to show Mikelats in his documented Hodei/Odei 'cloud' manifestation (mikelats-c04) as an active, overwhelming force, not a calm landscape. A colossal black storm cloud curls down in a spiral vortex, low over the viewer, filling about 60% of the frame. A dense diagonal barrage of real hailstones hammers an apple orchard: leaves are stripped, fruit is knocked down, and the ground is white with hail (makes storms, hurls stones and strikes fields and orchards with hail, c01/c02/c04). The sunset gap at the left is the single warm light and rims the cloud. Small white farmhouses in a green valley give scale and Basque context, with no people or victims. No face is hidden in the cloud, and there is no lightning, aura or text. At 200px the spiralling black mass and the hail barrage read as a destructive storm-being descending, dangerous rather than scenic.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, foot, hip and lower-left crops. One very corpulent humanlike figure (mohan-legendary-c10) with one head, two eyes in a hard glare at the viewer, and a heavy tangled beard. Abundant long, wet, unkempt hair pours over his head, shoulders, arms, torso and legs, covering much of his body (c10). An opaque coarse brown wrap covers the hips, and the groin is hidden behind the wrap, hair and net, so there is no nudity. Two arms: both hands (thumb plus four fingers where visible) violently haul a stolen fishing net with floats backward (steals fishermen's nets, c07). Two legs: the near bare foot, with five toes, braces on wet rock, and the far foot shows faintly through the net at lower left. He drags the net into a dark waterside cave by a moonlit jungle river at night (c11), with water streaming from it. No victims, captives, satyr parts, shapeshift or aura. The sheer hairy bulk, the glare and the forceful theft read as an uncanny river spirit, not an ordinary fisherman, at 200px. No text.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and hood/face, door-hand, stick-hand and door-ring crops. One man-like bogeyman in a long, ragged, pitch-black hooded cloak. The hood hides BOTH eyes in total darkness; only the nose tip shows above a thick grey-brown beard (mommotti-c03/c04). He grips one knotty wooden stick, and one battered, cracked black boot steps over the threshold (c03). Two hands: one clutches the door edge, with the visible fingers normal and none extra, and the other grips the stick (thumb plus four fingers). Moment: from an extreme low doorstep angle, he looms through the half-open door of an old stone village house at night, stooping toward the viewer as if he has heard a child (goes house to house listening, c04). A street lamp behind him is the one warm light. No sack, horns, children or aura. The iron door ring is hardware, not text. The faceless hood and the forward step make him a frightening bogeyman at 200px, not a passing traveller. A generic folk cloak, not a recognisable film or game design.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head, flank, back/tail and boat crops. One large dark serpent-like creature (moon-lake-monster-c04) with one blunt reptilian head, two small eyes, two nostrils and a closed mouth. The body is thick and limbless, with no legs, flippers, fins, horns or dorsal spikes. The back is covered in low, rounded, irregular scaled bumps like a 'bumpy log' (c06), which fixes the crocodile scutes of the self-rejected first attempt. The body trails back in an S-curve to a tapering tail. It swims straight at a water-level camera, pushing a clear V-shaped wake and spray (c04). The setting is a moonlit alpine lake with pines and snowy Uinta peaks (c01). An empty rowboat sits near the far shore, and in perspective the length stays in a plausible range, not a giant sea serpent. No victims, text or aura. The head-on approach at eye level, the dark wet mass and the wake make it a dangerous close encounter at 200px, not an ordinary animal.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, and knee/foot crops. One adult female spirit (mormo-c01) with one head, two eyes and a snarling open mouth with yellowed teeth. Two HUGE fleshy, veined ears rise from her head, each taller than her face (c03); they are ears, not horns or wings. She is on all fours (c03), crawling fast out of a dark stone passage toward a floor-level camera. Both hands splay on the flagstones, each counted at thumb plus four long fingers with dirty nails, and one knee and a bare foot advance under the robe. A fully opaque, ragged dark wool robe covers her body. The 'changing faces' (c03) are correctly not drawn as extra heads: there is one face, and no gore or children. One hot side light. The enormous ears, the crawling attack and the direct snarl make her an unmistakable, frightening bogey-monster at 200px, not an ordinary woman. The ears are generic, not a recognisable film or game goblin design. No text or aura.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head/teeth, coils and distant-canoe crops. One unmistakable horse head (mugwump-folklore-c09) with two upright horse ears, two dark eyes, flared nostrils and a wet dark mane; the white forehead star is editorial. The mouth is open in a bellow, showing horse incisors and pointed canine tushes. The head joins directly to a thick, limbless, scaled serpent body (c09), with no horse torso, legs, fins or wings. It rears out of the lake toward a water-level camera, throwing spray, while the rest of the body loops in coils through the surface behind, giving a length well over 20 feet (c04). The setting is a wide northern lake with a dark conifer shoreline at sunset (Lake Timiskaming, c01), with a small canoe beached far off on the shore and no one attacked. No text or aura. The horse head on a serpent body, the bared teeth and the rearing lunge make it a dangerous hybrid lake monster at 200px, not an ordinary swimming horse or a cute seahorse.

Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, leg/fin and hoof crops. The anatomy is faithful. One adult woman with one head and two eyes, in a fully opaque, high-necked, long-sleeved dark-green blouse. Two arms: the reaching hand and the hand on the rock each have a thumb plus four fingers. From the waist down she is scaled (mulher-marinha-c02), with two separate legs, fins along the outer side of each leg, and two cloven goat hooves, one planted and one lifted (c01/c02). There is no fish tail, nudity, text or aura, and the setting is a rocky Atlantic shore with surf (c03/c05). It still fails Uji Sangar #2 and #7. (1) The face is a glamour-portrait face: smooth, made-up-looking features with a serene, parted-lip model expression and the gaze drifting above the camera. This is the same 'ordinary attractive woman in a fashion shoot' problem flagged for la-diablesse in 2118-r02. (2) The low sun disc on the horizon, the orange sky and the sparkling surf make a golden-hour beach postcard. (3) At 200px the scaled legs read as scale-print leggings and the hooves as dark boots, and the fins almost vanish. She reads as a woman in a costume posing on rocks at sunset, not an awe-inspiring daughter of the sea (c10). A benevolent being must still be majestic and arresting, and this image is merely pretty.
results.correction_notes: Keep the anatomy exactly: one adult woman in a fully opaque, high-necked, long-sleeved top; scaled from the waist down; two separate legs with fins along both; two cloven goat hooves (mulher-marinha-c01/c02). Keep her benevolent, with no menace, sexualised framing, nudity or fish tail. Fix: (a) Awe, not glamour. She rises out of the sea itself (c03/c05/c10) as a wave breaks behind and above her, with seawater pouring off her shoulders and legs and wet hair heavy with kelp and salt. Her face is grave and otherworldly, with a steady, direct gaze at the viewer, not a smooth made-up model face or a dreamy look. (b) Make the hybrid anatomy read at 200px. Use larger, ragged, translucent fins along the legs. Make the scales visibly her own body (irregular, wet and catching the light), not tights. Put the goat hooves large in the foreground on black basalt. (c) Light: a dark Atlantic storm gap or a moonlit sea, with one strong shaft of light on her and flying spray. No sun disc on the horizon and no golden-hour postcard. Use a low camera, with her filling the frame from hooves to head.

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head, all-feet, upper-left-limb and rear-leg/tail crops. One giant goanna (mungoon-gali-c01) with one wedge-shaped monitor head, eyes in three-quarter view (one visible), small pointed teeth, and a long forked tongue flicking from a gaping mouth. Its rough, dark, ochre-speckled scales follow Australian monitor anatomy. Legs: two massive front legs plant in the foreground, each foot with five curved claws, and one rear leg steps down beside the tail. The remaining sprawled limb arches over the rock at the upper left, partly hidden, and no fifth foot can be read. It has one long tapering tail. The giant size (an ancestral form larger than today's five-foot goanna, c01/c05) shows against an empty bark shelter that it dwarfs, with no people. It scrambles down a red rock ledge straight at a ground-level camera, kicking up dust. The venomous bite (c01) is implied only by the open mouth, with no venom mist or victims. Dry eucalyptus country at sunset under one low sun, with no invented sacred motifs and no text. It dominates the frame and stays dangerous at 200px.
